capabilities: Copy a wikilink of a canvas node or group from the right-click menu
Use the node's first heading or the group label as link display text
Configure which heading level is extracted as the title
Show a notification on copy success or error
disambiguation: Not a tool for creating links between nodes; it only copies a single node's wikilink to the clipboard.
extras: The README references another plugin for users who don't need the node wikilink option, but the plugin's name is not shown in the text.
intentEvidence: adds a "Copy Node Link" entry to the right-click menu of any canvas node or group
problem: Obsidian's Canvas has no built-in way to copy a wikilink pointing at a specific node or group, so linking to nodes means manual URL or ID work.
summary: Canvas utility that adds a right-click menu entry to copy a wikilink of any canvas node or group, using headings or labels as display text.
